title: feat(artifacts): add ArtifactStore + ScreenTool artifact_ref (ADR phase 2)
head: feature/artifact-store-adr
body:
This draft PR introduces the minimal ArtifactStore, wiring into ToolResult via artifact_ref, and refactors ScreenTool to persist screenshots as artifacts instead of embedding binary data.

Summary of changes:
- laptop_control/artifacts/store.py: new ArtifactStore with SQLite metadata (WAL), atomic file writes, SHA-256 checksums, TTL expiration, strict 0700/0600 permissions, and size quotas.
- laptop_control/core/types.py: optional ToolResult.artifact_ref added.
- laptop_control/tools/screen.py: ScreenTool now uses ArtifactStore.create_artifact to persist PNG captures and returns artifact_ref.
- tests/*: unit tests for artifact store core behavior and authorization/MIME checks.

Priority follow-up checklist (in PR):
- [ ] Authorization Integration: Hook ArtifactStore methods into laptop_control/security/authorization.py to strictly validate session ownership (in-progress).
- [ ] MIME Magic-Byte Validation: Use python-magic with fallback manual checks for png/jpeg/webp/zip (in-progress).
- [ ] Emergency Stop & Audit Wiring: Interrupt active writes on emergency-stop and emit audit events (next).
- [ ] Operator CLI & Integration Tests: admin-only CLI + end-to-end tests with mocked capture (later).

Notes:
- For initial integration the ArtifactStore instance in ScreenTool is created with authorizer=None as a placeholder. The next commit will wire the real AuthorizationManager from the runtime dependency injection layer.
